<subject>Railcar 72B8C Incident Aboard MV OCEAN HAWK</subject>
<body>
Awaiting feedback from your team regarding:  
Coordination with adjuster on proceeding with Railcar 72B8C claim.  
Engaging a technical consultant to challenge the insurer's surveyor assessment.

A letter has been sent to the vessel owner requesting an extension for initiating legal proceedings (this safeguards the underwriter’s subrogation rights).

Clarification is being sought on the policy condition requiring a “suit” to be initiated against the underwriter within one year of the incident. Our broker believes this is unnecessary since the claim was lodged and remains open, but written confirmation will be obtained from the underwriter/adjuster.

Michael Boyer will contact the Fremantle-based legal counsel representing the insurer of Rail Logistics Australia regarding joining their action against the vessel owner.

If anyone has additional points or corrections to the above, please share now so we maintain alignment.
</body>
